description: This file defines a code fix provider class for handling attribute ID clashes within the Orleans.Analyzers namespace. It implements logic to register code fixes for diagnostics related to ID conflicts in attributes, including updating attribute IDs to resolve clashes.

classes.name: IdClashAttributeCodeFix
classes.description: A code fix provider class that offers automated fixes for attribute ID clash diagnostics in C# code within the Orleans.Analyzers namespace.

methods.name: FixableDiagnosticIds
methods.description: Property returning the diagnostic ID(s) that this code fix can address.

methods.name: GetFixAllProvider
methods.description: Provides a FixAllProvider to apply fixes to all occurrences.

methods.name: RegisterCodeFixesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously registers a code fix for a detected diagnostic by analyzing syntax nodes and proposing an automated ID increment correction.
